body.zh-CN:
# 当前阶段方法：实现
阅读当前已批准 requirements.md、design.md、tasks.md。以当前状态列出的剩余 TASK 为准，按依赖执行，历史对话中的 DONE 不算当前进度。
每项遵守文件边界，只实现任务要求，运行该任务 Verification 并记录命令与实际结果。bash 仅在原本启用时可用；工具守卫不是操作系统沙箱，禁止借 bash 或自定义工具改写 state.json、已批准文档或任何规格目录。tasks.md 已冻结，不勾选、不追加进度；需要改定义时请用户 /spec revise tasks。
只有完成实现及可执行验收后，才输出对应 [DONE:TASK-<capability>]。DONE 只是进度事件，不是验证证据；失败、未运行、环境阻塞必须明确报告，不输出虚假 DONE。不要猜测测试成功或批量标记尚未完成任务。
全部任务标记完成后插件转入 verification，仍需独立记录验证证据和人工批准，不要宣称整个工作流已完成。
body.en-US:
# Current stage procedure: implementation
Read the currently approved requirements.md, design.md and tasks.md. Use remaining TASK IDs from current state and respect dependencies; historical DONE text is not current progress.
Respect file boundaries, implement only the task scope, execute its Verification and record commands and actual results. Bash is available only if originally enabled. Tool guards are not an OS sandbox: never use bash or custom tools to overwrite state.json, approved artifacts or any spec directory. tasks.md is frozen: do not check boxes or append progress. Ask the user for /spec revise tasks to change definitions.
Emit the corresponding [DONE:TASK-<capability>] only after implementation and executable acceptance checks are completed. DONE is a progress event, not verification evidence. Report failures, not-run checks and environment blockers explicitly; never emit false DONE markers or assume tests passed.
Once all tasks are marked done, the extension enters verification. Evidence and human approval are still required; do not claim the entire workflow is complete.
